study.publication: Ragonese et al. 2025 Ecological Entomology DOI 10.1111/een.70010

analysis: Do not drop dead larvae. Separate missing survival outcomes; flag unexpected coding.
Describe n, pupation, adult eclosion and distinct plots/plants in the eight predefined 2x2x2 treatment cells.

For each parasite-treatment stratum, calculate descriptive host survival difference within ambient/elevated temperature and their difference-in-differences. Not an independently hypothesized mechanistic discovery.

No treatment-effect p-values from individual rows; original larvae are shared by plants and plots. Any future inferential uncertainty needs design-aware plot/plant grouping and author analysis reconciliation.
Do not select infection status after treatment or other observed descendants as an entry criterion.
forbidden: Inferring regional butterfly occupancy, newly introduced host use or population colonization from the rearing experiment
Treating the 2025 published host x thermal x parasite findings as novel chocho results
Using raw per-larva significance tests as though there were independent randomized populations
Converting 82 reconstructed introduced-added WGSRPD3 units to an actual fitness response
stop_rule: Stop if original repo cannot be pinned, expected fields missing, survival categories ambiguous, or cohort includes unresolved fates; report a source gate failure rather than inventing eclosion.
